product_one_liner.value: Verifiable automates healthcare provider credentialing, primary-source verification, and ongoing monitoring for health plans and healthcare provider organizations.

pricing_page.notes: No public pricing or plans page was found; the pricing URL did not return a page, and the site directs prospective buyers to contact sales.

eng_blog.notes: The blog is primarily industry, product, and marketing content; no two engineer-authored posts explaining how the product is built were established. Technical-sounding articles by operations and marketing leaders do not meet the specified test.

public_docs.notes: Public API documentation includes authentication, providers, credentialing requests, and other reference sections.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The board lists Customer Success Manager, Enterprise Customer Success Manager, and Solutions Engineer; none is a qualifying AI/ML or data-science role.

model_provider.notes: OpenAI is disclosed for credentialing data extraction, normalization, reasoning, and workflow assistance; Claude is disclosed for code generation, evaluation, testing, and workflow assistance connected with the platform and services. No specific OpenAI model is named.

compliance_certs.notes: SOC 2 Type II is an audited certification/compliance claim. HIPAA is a compliance claim with a standard BAA, not an independent certification.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest disclosed round is July 10, 2023, before the May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window; the company still reports $47 million in total funding.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: None of the three listed openings is an SDR, BDR, or Account Executive role.

launched_6mo.notes: The newest launch located was CredAgent on February 26, 2026, before the May 9–November 9, 2026 window; subsequent readable posts discuss it rather than announce a new major launch.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Aron Digumarthi joined Verifiable as Vice President, Customer Success in March 2026, within November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The job posting names Salesforce CRM; the subprocessor list names Zendesk for customer relationships and support; the privacy policy identifies Warmly for visitor identification supporting sales and marketing.
